items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: Tom Anderson used to run opium.

ctx.x: marijuana was really available in other things, in his neighborhood.

Well, in his neighborhood, what was hot was opium. Yeah. And people used to run opium. Mm-hmm. But, uh, you know, opium was an elaborate thing to go through, you had to have all the equipment and everything, and most people didn't bother with that. In fact, there wasn't a big thing with drugs in New Orleans in those days. Mm-hmm. Tom Anderson used to run opium.
